page.layout: One printed page, single text column; running head at top, page number top left; catchword at bottom right. No margin notes. Show-through and marks at the bottom left are not printed text.

main_text.p: definivit utrique sexui, intra quos inire conjugiafas[?] non esset, ne ex immaturis parentibus infirmi liberi ederentur, nec ipsorum juvenum ac virginum arbitrio desideriove id reliquit, (nam non tam parentibus ipsis quàm civitati gignie-ducarique sobolem volebat,) sic etiam annos praefinivit, ultra quos differri conjugium viris impune non permitte-retur, ne inter frequentia bella & casus alios forte oborientes, & fatales civium mortes sufficiens copia sobolis in decedentium locum succrescentis, Mavor-tiam civitatem destitueret. Nam qui ul-tra justum tempus coelibes manebant, eos variâ ignominiâ jussit affici velut legum contemptores, & patriæ salutem susque deque habentes. Voluit enim ut hyeme mediâ, imperante magistratu, nudi forum obirent, & in se composi-tam cantilenam canerent, eaque juste se poenas dare, quòd legibus non parerent, faterentur: ut spectaculis certaminum gymnicorum arcerentur: ut honorum, quos juvenes senibus Spartę debebant, participes haud essent. Quorum omnium testis locuples est Plutarchus.
Annum coelibatui impuni determinatum nec apud Plutarchum, nec apud quenquam scriptorum veterum reperio. Ex Platone, in libris ejus iiii

page.notes: Printed text in the running head and page number is clear. Long s is transcribed as s; u/v and i/j normalised. Doubtful: "conjugiafas" (possibly two words, "conjugia fas") and catchword "& vi" (could be "& ut"). The column ends at "iiii"; the following line of the original (the Plutarch/Platon reference continuation, "& vi") is the catchword only. Bottom left: partly legible marks "appa", "ahde" and "ꝑ ꝑ" are show-through from the reverse side and were not transcribed. Faint partial letter "m" at the start of the line "reperio" is edge or show-through. Some marks in the lower left margin are unclear and are not transcribed.
